module: D09-14 Market Share／Entry Barrier／Substitution／Competitive Strategy市占、進入障礙、替代與競爭策略
deduplicatedScope: Firm-specific competitive action and relative-position lifecycle. Static industry structure/share/barrier/substitution state remains owned by D09-13.

receipts.announcedAction: Additional US$100bn intended investment; total planned U.S. investment US$165bn; three new fabs, two advanced-packaging facilities and R&D center.
receipts.laterImplementationEvidence: 2025 annual report states Arizona first fab already HVM since 4Q24, second-fab schedule pulled forward toward H2 2027 HVM, and third-fab construction began in 2025.
receipts.keyFalsification: Announced investment amount is not operating capacity; lifecycle fields are required.

receipts.announcedAction: Singapore new fab unveiled; first phase to start volume production in 2026; first phase planned full capacity 30,000 wafers/month; Singapore total capacity expected above 1m wafers/year.
receipts.keyFalsification: Grand opening does not equal HVM, qualified capacity or steady-state available capacity.

receipts.announcedAction: Joint development of 12nm platform using Intel U.S. manufacturing capacity; production expected 2027.
receipts.keyFalsification: Entry/technology advancement can occur through partnership and shared capacity; own-fab capex is not the only competitive-strategy route.

divergentStateEvidence.D0913State: Semiconductor foundry entry barriers remain high.
divergentStateEvidence.D0914State: UMC uses Intel capacity/technology collaboration to lower upfront capital burden and accelerate 12nm roadmap.
divergentStateEvidence.conclusion: Firm action can alter relative position without eliminating industry-level barriers.

divergentStateEvidence.D0913State: Industry capacity context may remain unchanged today.
divergentStateEvidence.D0914State: UMC Singapore facility is unveiled but HVM is future-dated.
divergentStateEvidence.conclusion: Firm strategy changes before physical industry capacity state fully changes.

divergentStateEvidence.D0913State: Current industry structure is observed from present output/capacity.
divergentStateEvidence.D0914State: TSMC commits to multi-fab/advanced-packaging geographic expansion with staged implementation.
divergentStateEvidence.conclusion: Long-horizon strategic positioning is a distinct firm-level state.

uniquePitReplayContract.noIntentInference: Use observable action/implementation facts; do not infer management motive beyond documented company language.
uniquePitReplayContract.outcomeFirewall: No stock-return, margin or share-gain outcome while freezing the action state.

antiDoubleCountRules: Static industry market share, barriers, substitution and bargaining power remain D09-13.
D09-14 receives an independent state only when actor-specific action and lifecycle fields are present.
The same capacity figure cannot simultaneously count as D09-13 industry barrier evidence and D09-14 strategic-action alpha; one parent receipt, different analytical role.
Physical capacity stage is linked to D10-04 rather than duplicated.
Announcement/event clock is linked to D11/D17 rather than duplicated.
promotionReason: Official issuer/partner releases provide replayable, dated firm-specific strategic-action states with implementation lifecycles that can diverge from static industry structure. This establishes a distinct PIT/replay contract for D09-14 after scope deduplication.
reasonNoL4: No prospective/OOS evidence that action states improve stock selection, future share gains, margins or returns; action outcomes can fail, delay or be offset by industry/regime effects.
exactNext: Accumulate independent issuer actions across at least one non-semiconductor industry and one failed/delayed/cancelled strategic-action control.
Freeze post-action relative-position outcomes only on native publication clocks.
Test incremental value versus D09-13 industry structure, D10 capacity, D11 event and D07 fundamentals before any System1/System2 use.
